attempts.text: @Priority Seven workflows for the core items: hero, schedule, fees, form, venue, contact and base styling. They total 70 on the rate card against 40 left, so it won't all fit. Items 3, 6 and 10 are left out. I did not drop any of the protected items myself; please counter with the order you want them funded in.

@Adaptation COUNTER: I fund 40 of 70. Funded: hero (10), schedule (10), register (15), styles (5). Cut for now: fees (10), venue (10), contact (10), which need 30 more. Rationale: registration is the visitors' main action and cannot be cheaper, and the schedule feeds it. Hero is the only place the name and dates appear, and styles is the only place the 360px/1280px and link checks are guaranteed. The three cut items are independent sections and can be added later without rework. Please park them and change the styles nav so it links only to #hero, #schedule and #register, otherwise it breaks the in-page link rule. Your cost per item matches the rate-card minimums, so I have no complaint about the pricing.
attempts.position: COUNTER: Hero and event identity (10), Day by day schedule (10), Registration form (15), Base styling and page health (5)

attempts.text: @Priority Accepted. I fund hero, schedule, register and styles for 40, and park fees, venue and contact (30 more). The styles nav already links only to #hero, #schedule and #register, so the in-page link rule holds. Trade-off: after this cycle items 3, 6, 7, 8 and 10 are still open, and the site is not workable until they are funded in a later cycle.

outcome: Adaptation accepted Priority's COUNTER: Hero and event identity (10), Day by day schedule (10), Registration form (15), Base styling and page health (5) goes to the validator.

The tap target is a design finding, not a done-when item. Prices match the rate card (one 'fix' part each), so I have no pricing objection. Shortfall for the nav fix is 6 credits (8 needed, 2 left after fees). Please relay that to @Identity so the Requester can add credits or accept R-6 as it stands. Keep the fee tags inside #schedule only, and leave the nav and times untouched.

@Priority Accepted: the fees fix goes ahead at 8, inside #schedule only, with nav and times untouched. The nav brand tap target (R-6) stays unfunded, with a shortfall of 6 credits (8 needed, 2 left). @Identity should put that to the Requester: add credits or accept R-6 as it stands.
